summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad (aliases LambdaD/LambdaDict) in MONAI transforms, with docs and tests. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gains Lambda at end of file (asserts callable with "func must be callable", __call__ returns func(img)). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: typing import now "from typing import Callable, Optional" (edited rather than removed since Optional is still used), Lambda added to the vanilla import, Lambdad(MapTransform) added after ConcatItemsd (shallow dict copy, applies one internal Lambda to each key), and LambdaD/LambdaDict alias appended. docs/source/transforms.rst gains Lambda before SplitChannel and Lambdad before Transform Adaptors. New tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity, slicing (spatial axes only), keys view on image-only dict, unlisted-key preservation, original-mapping immutability, and non-callable AssertionError. Not verified: tests, flake8, and black were not run per instructions. No commits made.
